blocks.text: Chapter 6 presents the genealogies of the Levite clans—Gershon, Kohath, and Merari—and traces the priestly succession from Aaron through his son Eleazar and his descendants, including Zadok, who is noted as the priest serving in Solomon's temple (verse 10). The chapter also records Jehozadak's deportation when Nebuchadnezzar took Judah and Jerusalem into captivity (verse 15). By recording these genealogies of priests and Levites alongside their connections to the temple and the experience of exile, chapter 6 functions as part of Chronicles' broader effort to link the restored postexilic community to the preexilic priesthood, Levitical tribes, and Jerusalem institutions.
